videos.title: The Japanese Secret to More Flavorful Fish
videos.author: Bon Appétit
videos.description:
Discover kobujime, a traditional Japanese technique for curing fish using kombu seaweed. Fish is lightly salted and pressed between sheets of sake-cleaned kombu, enhancing its natural umami flavor and creating a firmer texture.
